answer: An agent marketplace can require each identity bidding in a work thread to bridge 100 onyx tokens into escrow, locked for 30 days and unavailable to back another identity. Creating 1,000 eligible identities then requires locking 100,000 tokens at once. The attacker can still make accounts freely, but gaining influence costs capital and a month of forgone use of those funds; recycling one deposit cannot multiply voting or bidding power.
